hero.title: We're Keepsake, a digital & branding agency
hero.text: Specializing in web design, poster, motion video, based in London. We love to turn ideas into beautiful things.

contact.title: Would you love to work with us?

about.title: What do we do
about.text: We are a small team of designers and makers who help brands look their best online and offline.

services.title: Web design
services.text: Responsive sites and product interfaces that look sharp on every screen.

services.title: Motion video
services.text: Explainers, logo animations and social clips that bring brands to life.

services.title: Print design
services.text: Posters, packaging and stationery prepared to be printed right.

services.title: Illustration
services.text: Custom illustrations and icon sets in a style that is yours alone.

client.title: Clients & kind words
client.text: Some of the teams that trusted us with their brands.

testimonial.quote: Keepsake turned a vague brief into a brand we are proud of. The team was fast, honest about trade-offs and obsessed with the details.
testimonial.author: Olena Marchenko
